versions.changelog:
auto-lamp-ip-advisor v1.0.0 – First public release for automotive lamp supply chain and IP risk analysis.

- Provides expert analysis on car lamp designs or parts lists through four stages: module breakdown, make-or-buy decision, patent infringement risk assessment (invention, utility model and design, with global coverage), and summary strategy recommendations.
- Outputs an interactive web-based Tab-navigation HTML report, packaged as a downloadable zip file.
- Covers Chinese and major global patent offices (US, EP, JP, KR, DE); familiar with key industry players' patent portfolios.
- Includes design, procurement, and comprehensive patent risk mitigation guidance tailored for automotive lighting supply chains.
